## 0.2.237

owes: none — marked feeds, cities and instruments are called *favourites* in the five locales (words only: keys, routes and the `*.hearts` collections keep their names), and a single feed's favourite toggle moves from the `⋮` view panel into the header beside the unread counter, so `POST /feeds/source/{id}/heart` and `…/unheart` now redirect to the bare feed path (no `?view=open`); no route, record, CSP or wire change, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: none — *Manage watchlist* (`/stocks/watchlist`) is rebuilt as category sections of rows with a `⋮` per row, and every stocks board layout and the instrument page draw a labelled kind icon (twelve new `stocks.*` catalogue keys in five locales); moving an instrument now swaps it with its neighbour within the same category only (the stored `sortOrder` values are unchanged in shape, no migration); no route, record, CSP or wire change, rollback safe.
